name: CLA-NeRF
definition: A differentiable representation for articulated objects that explicitly models part and joint attributes, disentangling camera pose, part pose, part segmentation, and joint attributes to allow independent control during rendering.
summary: CLA-NeRF is a neural radiance field that renders articulated objects without CAD models by predicting part segmentation to infer joint attributes, distinguishing itself from methods requiring known joint parameters.
